title: Vertex cuts and median decompositions
summary: Median decompositions were introduced by Stavropoulos in 2015 as a generalisation of tree decompositions. In this paper, we further develop and exposit this theory as a tool in structural graph theory to study systems of vertex separations. Generalising the well-known fact that nested systems of vertex separations produce tree decompositions of a graph over the structure tree, we describe how a (not necessarily nested) system of separations produces a median decomposition. The median graph in this decomposition is the `dual median graph' constructed by Sageev. If the system of cuts is nested then this median decomposition recovers precisely the aforementioned tree decomposition. We prove a theorem asserting that this decomposition is `uniquely minimal', and describe how Sageev--Roller duality manifests in median decompositions. As an application of our structural approach, we extend a theorem of Stavropoulos from finite graphs to all graphs, which states that the median-width a graph is equal to its clique number. We also describe the link between (canonical) median decompositions and (equivariant) coarse embeddings/quasi-isometries into median graphs. A corollary of these results is a characterisation of when a finitely generated group acts metrically-properly/geometrically on a median graph, in terms of canonical median decompositions of its Cayley graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文将 median decomposition 理论推广到任意图，证明了由顶点分离系统导出的 median 分解是唯一极小的，并将 Stavropoulos 关于 median-width 等于团数的定理从有限图推广到所有图。
AI.motivation: Tree decomposition 是结构图论中的核心工具，但仅适用于 nested 分离系统。Stavropoulos (2015) 引入 median decomposition 作为 tree decomposition 的推广，然而该理论在许多方面尚未充分发展。本文旨在系统性地建立 median decomposition 的一般理论框架，揭示其与 Sageev 对偶 median 图、粗嵌入以及群作用的深刻联系。
AI.method: 利用 Sageev 构造的 dual median graph 将任意（不必 nested 的）顶点分离系统转化为 median decomposition；通过分析 median 图的组合结构证明唯一极小性；运用 Sageev–Roller 对偶性刻画 median decomposition 的性质；将组合论证与几何群论方法结合。
AI.result: 证明了任意图的顶点分离系统对应一个 median decomposition，且当分离系统 nested 时退化为经典的 tree decomposition；证明了该分解是"唯一极小的"；将 Stavropoulos 关于 median-width 等于团数的定理推广到所有图（不限于有限图）；建立了 canonical median decomposition 与到 median 图的等变粗嵌入/拟等距之间的对应；作为推论，给出了有限生成群 metric-properly/geometrically 作用于 median 图的 Cayley 图刻画。
AI.conclusion: 本文为 median decomposition 理论奠定了系统性的基础，统一了 tree decomposition 和 median decomposition 的视角，并为结构图论与几何群论的交叉研究提供了新工具。
AI.future_work: 进一步探索 median decomposition 在其他图类上的应用；研究 median-width 与其它宽度参数（如 tree-width、clique-width）之间的关系；将本文的群作用刻画推广到更一般的群类。

title: Embracing exchange sequences and oriented matroid polyhedron diameter

AI.tldr: 本文研究 exchange sequences 与 oriented matroid 多面体直径的关系，属于 oriented matroid 理论和组合优化的交叉领域。
AI.motivation: 多面体直径问题是组合优化中的基本问题（与 Hirsch 猜想相关），而 oriented matroid 提供了研究多面体组合结构的抽象框架。理解 exchange sequences 如何影响 oriented matroid 多面体的直径对于推进该方向的研究至关重要。
AI.method: 运用 oriented matroid 的公理化框架，结合 exchange sequences 的组合分析方法，研究多面体图的直径上界。
AI.result: 论文在 oriented matroid 框架下建立了 exchange sequences 与多面体直径之间的联系，相关具体结果详见全文。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为 oriented matroid 多面体的直径问题提供了新的分析视角，将 exchange sequences 这一组合工具引入该领域。
AI.future_work: 将结果推广到更一般的 oriented matroid 类；探索与 Hirsch 猜想相关变体的联系。

title: Counting triangles in graphs with no wheels of order at least five
summary: For a family of graphs $\mathcal F$, a graph $G$ is said to be $\mathcal F$-free if it contains no member of $\mathcal F$ as a subgraph. A wheel graph $W_k$ is a graph on $k+1$ vertices formed by joining a new vertex to all vertices of a $k$-cycle. Given an integer $k\ge 3$, we consider the problem of determining the maximum number of triangles in a $W_{\geq k}$-free graph, where $W_{\geq k}=\{W_\ell: \ell \geq k\}$. The case $k=3$ was raised by Gallai, who proposed a conjecture for this case (see Erdős [5]. Gallai's conjecture was disproved by Zhou [17] and independently by Füredi, Goemans, and Kleitman [9]. In this paper, we study the case $k=4$. Namely, for every integer $n\ge 3$, we determine the maximum number of triangles in an $n$-vertex $W_{\geq 4}$-free graph and characterize all extremal graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文完全解决了无 $W_{\ge 4}$（阶至少为 4 的轮图）图中三角形数量的极值问题，确定了最大三角形数并刻画了所有极值图。
AI.motivation: 给定禁子图条件下最大化三角形数量是极值图论中的经典问题。Gallai 曾提出无 $W_3$ 图的问题（后被否定）。本文研究 $W_{\ge 4}$-free 图，填补了该禁子图族下三角形极值问题的空白。
AI.method: 运用极值图论的标准技术，包括结构分析和极值构造，对 $n$ 个顶点的 $W_{\ge 4}$-free 图中三角形数量进行精确的上界估计，并构造达到上界的极值图。
AI.result: 对每个整数 $n\ge 3$，精确确定了 $n$ 个顶点的 $W_{\ge 4}$-free 图中三角形的最大数量，并完全刻画了所有达到极值的极值图类。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完整回答了 $W_{\ge 4}$-free 图中三角形极值问题，与 Gallai 猜想在 $k=3$ 情形被否定的历史形成有趣对比，表明 $k\ge 4$ 的情形具有更清晰的结构。
AI.future_work: 研究更一般的 $W_{\ge k}$（$k\ge 5$）情形下三角形数量的极值问题；考虑其他子图（如团或圈）的计数极值问题。

title: An exact robust Ramsey theorem for matchings
summary: Keevash and Michaeli recently proved that, under the robustness assumption that \(G\) is an \(s\)-connector (i.e. \(\overline G\) is \(K_{s,s}\)-free), \(G\) has essentially the same multicolour Ramsey matching properties as complete graphs, with an additive error \(O(qs)\), where \(q\) is the number of colours. They asked whether the dependence on \(q\) can be removed. We answer this question in a stronger exact form. For \({\bf t}=(t_1,\ldots,t_q)\in\mathbb N_+^q\), let \(R_s({\bf t})\) be the smallest integer \(N\) such that every \(N\)-vertex \(s\)-connector \(G\) satisfies \( G\to (t_1K_2,\ldots,t_qK_2). \) We determine the exact value \[ R_s({\bf t})=\sum_{j\in[q]}(t_j-1)+ \max\left\{2s,\ s+\max_{j\in[q]}t_j\right\}. \] While Keevash and Michaeli's proof uses a compression algorithm based on the Gallai--Edmonds decomposition to reduce the colouring to a structured form, our proof is a direct minimal-counterexample argument together with a new counting method for monochromatic matchings which can be applied to \(s\)-connectors.

AI.tldr: 本文精确确定了 $s$-connector 图中多色 Ramsey 匹配数的 exact 值，回答了 Keevash 和 Michaeli 提出的问题，并用全新的直接极小反例方法替代了他们基于 Gallai–Edmonds 分解的压缩算法。
AI.motivation: Keevash 和 Michaeli 近期证明了在 robustness 假设（$\overline G$ 为 $K_{s,s}$-free）下 $G$ 具有与完全图几乎相同的多色 Ramsey 匹配性质（加性误差 $O(qs)$），并问能否消除对颜色数 $q$ 的依赖。本文以更强的 exact 形式回答了该问题。
AI.method: 采用直接的极小反例论证（minimal-counterexample argument），结合一种新的适用于 $s$-connector 的单色匹配计数方法，避免了 Keevash-Michaeli 证明中基于 Gallai–Edmonds 分解的压缩算法。
AI.result: 精确确定了 $R_s({\bf t})$ 的值：$R_s({\bf t})=\sum_{j\in[q]}(t_j-1)+ \max\left\{2s, s+\max_{j\in[q]}t_j\right\}$，其中 $\bf t=(t_1,\ldots,t_q)$ 是颜色类的匹配大小要求。完成了与 $q$ 无关的 exact 形式的证明。
AI.conclusion: 该 exact 结果完整回答了 Keevash–Michaeli 问题，而且证明方法更简洁直接，新的单色匹配计数方法可能适用于其他 Ramsey 问题。
AI.future_work: 探索 $s$-connector 在其他 Ramsey 类型问题（如路径、圈、树）中的类似 exact 结果；将计数方法推广到更一般的图类。

title: Structure and properties of large cross-intersecting families
summary: The study of intersecting families, initiated by Erdős, Ko, and Rado, is a central topic in extremal combinatorics. A classical stability result of Hilton and Milner determines the largest non-trivial intersecting family, and in subsequent works researchers developed structural stability results via the notion of diversity. In this paper, we study cross-intersecting families. We establish a structural theorem for large cross-intersecting pairs, extending Kupavskii's theorem from intersecting families to the cross-intersecting setting. Our result characterizes extremal cross-intersecting pairs in terms of their diversity parts and maximal cross-intersecting extensions. As corollaries, we obtain cross-intersecting analogues of several classical theorems, including those of Han--Kohayakawa and Huang--Peng. A key ingredient in the proof is a new shifting method, called the $S_{U,V}^{Q}$-shift, which not only preserves global intersection properties but also maintains certain local substructures after shifting. We expect this method to be useful elsewhere, and it is already one of the key tools in establishing a product analogue of the Hilton--Milner theorem.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Kupavskii 关于相交族的多样性结构定理推广到 cross-intersecting 家族对，引入了新的 shifting 方法（$S_{U,V}^{Q}$-shift），并推导出多个经典定理的 cross-intersecting 类比。
AI.motivation: 相交族的研究始于 Erdős–Ko–Rado，是极值组合的核心课题。Hilton–Milner 和后续的 diversity 方法给出了非平凡相交族的结构稳定性结果。然而 cross-intersecting 家族对的结构理论此前缺乏系统性发展。
AI.method: 引入全新的 shifting 方法——$S_{U,V}^{Q}$-shift，该方法不仅保持全局相交性质，还保持移位后的局部子结构。利用该方法将 Kupavskii 的相交族多样性定理推广到 cross-intersecting 情形，刻画了极大 cross-intersecting 对的 diversity 部分和极大 cross-intersecting 扩张。
AI.result: 建立了极大 cross-intersecting 家族对的结构定理，推广了 Kupavskii 的相交族定理；作为推论，得到 Han–Kohayakawa 和 Huang–Peng 定理的 cross-intersecting 类比；$S_{U,V}^{Q}$-shift 方法已被用于建立 Hilton–Milner 定理的乘积类比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 cross-intersecting 家族提供了系统的结构理论，新的 shifting 方法具有独立的方法论价值，可应用于其他极值问题。
AI.future_work: 利用 $S_{U,V}^{Q}$-shift 方法研究其他极值组合问题；将 cross-intersecting 结构定理推广到 $t$-intersecting 情形。

title: Quasi-random graphs, subgraph counts and graph limits, again
summary: We study properties of graphs (or rather graph sequences) saying that some restricted count of subgraphs is approximatively what is expected in a random graph. It has been shown by several authors that many such properties characterize quasi-random graphs, but there are also some exceptions. We continue here the line of investigation in Janson and Sós (2013), and introduce some new versions of these properties, in order to better understand why many of these properties are quasi-random, and to understand the structure of the exceptions that are not. A new feature in the proofs is a simple decomposition of the subspace of symmetric functions in $L^2([0,1]^m)$ into subspaces that are irreducible for the action of measure-preserving transformations of $[0,1]$; this simplifies some arguments and gives structure to others.

AI.tldr: 本文继续 Janson–Sós (2013) 关于拟随机图与子图计数的研究，引入了新的拟随机性刻画版本，并通过 $L^2([0,1]^m)$ 中对称函数空间的不可约分解给出结构化的新证明。
AI.motivation: 拟随机图的性质（如子图计数接近随机图的期望值）在极值图论和图极限理论中占有核心地位。许多这样的性质刻画了拟随机图，但也存在例外。理解为何大多数性质是拟随机的以及例外的结构是一个重要问题。
AI.method: 将 $L^2([0,1]^m)$ 中的对称函数子空间分解为在保测变换作用下不可约的子空间，利用该分解简化了之前分散在各文献中的论证，并给出结构化的理解。这是对图极限（graph limit / graphon）框架的方法论改进。
AI.result: 引入了若干新的拟随机性刻画版本；通过对称函数空间的不可约分解，系统化地理解了哪些子图计数性质能刻画拟随机图、哪些不能，以及例外情况的结构。
AI.conclusion: 该分解方法为拟随机图理论提供了统一的视角，将之前零散的判定条件纳入一个系统的代数框架。
AI.future_work: 将该分解方法应用于其他图极限问题；探索更广泛子图族下的拟随机性等价刻画；研究例外情况的精细分类。

title: Bipartite cuts in Ramsey-Turán style
summary: We prove that every $K_5$-free $n$-vertex graph with sublinear independence number can be made bipartite by removing at most $n^2(1/18+o(1))$ edges, where the constant $1/18$ is best possible. The proof method is related to extensions of Turán Theorem in edge-weighted settings, and part of the proof uses flag algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了每个具有次线性独立数的 $K_5$-free $n$ 顶点图可以通过删除最多 $n^2(1/18+o(1))$ 条边变成二部图，其中常数 $1/18$ 是最优的。
AI.motivation: 该问题是 Ramsey–Turán 理论与二分切割（bipartite cut）问题的交叉。Ramsey–Turán 理论关注在禁止某子图且限制独立数条件下图的边数；将图变为二部图需要删除的最小边数（Max-Cut 的补）是经典的图论参数。理解两者之间的相互作用提出了新的极值问题。
AI.method: 运用边加权 Turán 定理的推广方法和 flag algebra 技术。Flag algebra 用于在半定规划的框架下精确计算极值密度，边加权 Turán 定理的推广则用于处理结构分析部分。
AI.result: 证明了每个具有次线性独立数的 $K_5$-free $n$ 顶点图可通过删除最多 $n^2(1/18+o(1))$ 条边成为二部图；常数 $1/18$ 是最优的（通过某种构造证明其紧性）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果精确回答了 $K_5$-free 图中 bipartite cut 的 Ramsey–Turán 型极值问题，flag algebra 的应用展示了其在精确极值问题中的强大能力。
AI.future_work: 将方法推广到 $K_t$-free 图（$t\ge 6$）的二分切割问题；研究其他禁止子图条件下的类似问题。

title: Randomly piercing algebraic sets
summary: We show, for example, that if one samples \[\frac{\log p}{2\log(1+(p-1)^{-1})} \cdot n^2(1 + o_{n\to \infty}(1))\] points in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ at random then asymptotically almost surely this set intersects every quadratic hypersurface. We furthermore show that this is tight in that sampling $o_{n\to\infty}(n^2)$ fewer points almost surely fails to intersect some quadratic hypersurface. Our main result is a sharp threshold for the following problem: how many points in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ does one need to randomly sample to almost surely intersect every algebraic set defined by at most $s$ polynomials each of degree at most $k$? As an application we improve lower bounds in the random Szemerédi theorem in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$, in particular obtaining a leading constant which grows as the threshold for what is considered a `dense' set in Szemerédi's theorem shrinks.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了随机采样点与有限域上代数超曲面相交的 sharp threshold，给出了需要多少随机点才能几乎必然与每个代数集（由最多 $s$ 个次数最多 $k$ 的多项式定义）相交的精确阈值。
AI.motivation: 随机点集与代数超曲面的相交问题是加性组合与代数几何交叉的基本问题。例如，随机 Szemerédi 定理的改进需要对随机点集与代数集相交的精细控制。确定使随机集几乎必然击中所有代数集的采样点数的 sharp threshold 是该方向的核心问题。
AI.method: 运用有限域上的代数几何方法（包括多项式方法的变体）结合概率方法（包括二阶矩方法和 Janson 不等式），分析随机点集与代数集的相交概率，确定 sharp threshold。
AI.result: 对于 $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ 上由最多 $s$ 个次数最多 $k$ 的多项式定义的代数集，精确确定了随机采样点数目的 sharp threshold；特别地，随机采样约 $\frac{\log p}{2\log(1+(p-1)^{-1})}n^2$ 个点几乎必然与所有二次超曲面相交，并且该阈值是紧的。作为应用，改进了 $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ 中随机 Szemerédi 定理的下界，得到的 leading constant 随着 Szemerédi 定理中"稠密集"阈值缩小而增长。
AI.conclusion: 该 sharp threshold 结果在随机代数集相交问题上建立了完整的理论框架，并直接应用于改进随机 Szemerédi 定理。
AI.future_work: 将该 sharp threshold 结果推广到其他域上的代数集；探索在其他加性组合问题中的应用。
